# Maninder Singh

> Full-stack and cloud developer building real-time, AI-powered, and offline-first systems with the MERN stack, Spring Boot, and AWS.

Maninder Singh combines backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI. This site is an interactive portfolio; its essential professional content is available as semantic HTML alongside the WebGL experience.

## Primary resource

- [Portfolio](https://itsmaninder-singh.github.io/): Canonical portfolio containing education, training, selected projects, and contact options. Use the site navigation to reach individual sections.

## Professional focus

- Full-stack web applications: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, Spring Boot, REST APIs, JWT, and WebSockets.
- Databases and caching: MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL (pgvector), Redis, Qdrant.
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway), Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, serverless architecture.
- Applied AI: retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, OpenAI API, Gemini API.
- Interactive experiences: Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, scroll-driven animation, and motion architecture (this portfolio itself).

## Selected work

- **Argus Kernel** — Full-Stack Developer, Jan 2026 – Present. AI-native API firewall protecting LLM applications from prompt injection, sensitive data leakage (PII redaction), and abuse across OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Groq, and Ollama.
- **DevConnect** — Backend Developer, Jan–Mar 2026. Real-time platform for finding hackathon and project teammates; owns the Team, ProjectMate, Join Requests, and Matchup backend modules, including a weighted matching algorithm.
- **Vector** — Full-Stack Developer. AI career-guidance platform for college students with a React Three Fiber and Framer Motion front end, powered by the Gemini API.
- **TapPay** — Full-Stack Developer. Offline-first UPI payment system using encrypted QR tokens and an automated sync-and-reconciliation engine.
- **Manexa** — Full-Stack Developer. Multi-tenant school management system covering timetables, exams, results, and library management.
- **RepoMind** — Backend Developer. AI assistant that answers natural-language questions about any GitHub repository using retrieval-augmented generation.
- **Serverless Cloud Notes App** — Developer, May 2026. Serverless notes application on AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, S3, and SNS, built as a university systems assessment.

## Portfolio implementation

The portfolio itself is a TypeScript and Vite application that uses Three.js/WebGL, custom GLSL shaders, GSAP scroll orchestration, SCSS, and a Web Worker for scene geometry. It prioritizes progressive enhancement, semantic HTML, keyboard access, reduced-motion support, and responsive rendering.
